name: Processing Status 102 Choice
definition: Choice of format for the processing status.

PendingCancellation.name: Pending Cancellation
PendingCancellation.definition: Cancellation request from yourself for this instruction is pending waiting for further processing.

AcknowledgedAccepted.name: Acknowledged Accepted
AcknowledgedAccepted.definition: Instruction has been acknowledged by the account servicer.

PendingProcessing.name: Pending Processing
PendingProcessing.definition: Instruction has been acknowledged by the account servicer, but processing of the instruction is pending.

Rejected.name: Rejected
Rejected.definition: Instruction/Request has been rejected for further processing.

Repair.name: Repair
Repair.definition: Instruction has been acknowledged by the account servicer but is in repair.

Cancelled.name: Cancelled
Cancelled.definition: Instruction has been cancelled (only as a response to a SecuritiesTransactionStatusQuery). The status on the processing of a cancellation request must be provided using a SecuritiesTransactionCancellationRequestStatusAdvice.

Proprietary.name: Proprietary
Proprietary.definition: Status that cannot be reported using one of the available standard status.

CancellationRequested.name: Cancellation Requested
CancellationRequested.definition: Cancellation request from your counterparty for this transaction is pending waiting for your cancellation request or your consent.

ModificationRequested.name: Modification Requested
ModificationRequested.definition: Modification request from your counterparty for this transaction is pending waiting for your cancellation request or your consent.
